an4.274:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an4.274:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhā domanassaṃ.
an4.274:1.4: vedanāsu …pe… citte …pe… dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhā domanassaṃ.
an4.274:1.5: rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbāti.
